# Module `navigator`

What the web APIs of JavaScript need beyond the modules Wasm pages use (native/js/runtime/web*.c): the browser's
identity for navigator, beacons, the screen, media queries scripts evaluate (matchMedia), and FormData file entries.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/js_web.widl`.

## Types

### enum `NavigatorField` : i32

A string member of Navigator.

| member | value | |
|---|---:|---|
| `User_Agent` | 0 | navigator.userAgent: the User-Agent header the browser sends (network.user_agent). |%!(EXTRA false)
| `App_Version` | 1 | navigator.appVersion: the user agent without its leading "Mozilla/". |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Platform` | 2 | navigator.platform ("Win32"). |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Vendor` | 3 | navigator.vendor. |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Languages` | 4 | navigator.languages, comma separated, from the Accept-Language preference (network.accept_language), without quality values. |%!(EXTRA true)
| `Do_Not_Track` | 5 | navigator.doNotTrack: "1", or "" for null (privacy.do_not_track). |%!(EXTRA false)
